create_BERT_connector: create a Bert connector instance that loads a pre-trained BERT model for masked language modeling
get_batch_generation_Bert: get batch generation log probabilities and token IDs for a list of sentences with masked tokens
get_contextual_embeddings_Bert: get contextual embeddings from all BERT encoder layers for a batch of sentences
tokenize_with_custom_tokenizer: tokenize text using CustomBaseTokenizer that preserves MASK tokens without splitting them
get_id_Bert: get token IDs for a string by tokenizing and converting tokens to vocabulary indices
